entity.name: Singaraj B
entity.description: Self-taught ML engineer based in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu. Author of morisien-embed, the first embedding model for Kreol Morisien, archived on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21877805), and of sante-embed, a 1.5B medical retrieval model across nine languages. Merged contributions to MTEB, sentence-transformers, PEFT and Haystack, including MorisienMTBitextMining, the first Mauritian Creole task in MTEB, with model registrations and results published to embeddings-benchmark/results. No degree, no institutional affiliation.

projects.name: morisien-embed
projects.description: morisien-embed is a complete, released pipeline for building evaluation coverage for a language that had none: corpus assembly, leakage audit enforced by tests, MTEB task merged upstream, model trained, results published. MIT licensed throughout, trained in 45 minutes on a free Kaggle T4. This grant applies the same pipeline to Indian languages. Measured against the current MTEB task registry: Tamil has 31 tasks and Malayalam 29, but zero reranking and one STS task each. Bhojpuri has 6 and Maithili 7, with zero retrieval, zero STS and zero reranking. Maithili is a scheduled language of India. All-time downloads: 1140 across morisien-embed, morisien-embed-v1.5 and sante-embed. MorisienMTBitextMining is merged into MTEB and runs as part of the multilingual benchmark, with results published to embeddings-benchmark/results.

plans.name: Leak-audited MTEB evaluation coverage for Indian languages
plans.description: Builds the missing MTEB categories for Tamil, Malayalam, Bhojpuri and Maithili: leak-audited, merged into MTEB, with models trained against them. Tamil has 31 tasks and Malayalam 29, but zero reranking and one STS each. Bhojpuri has 6 and Maithili 7, with zero retrieval, STS or reranking. Budget: INR 180000 native-speaker data (Bhojpuri and Maithili, 60 days each at INR 1500/day); INR 60000 annotation; INR 160000 maintainer time; INR 30000 compute. 56% of the grant goes to native speakers.
